create_qat_embedding: create a quantization aware training Embedding module with fake quantize weight for training
create_qat_embedding_bag: create a quantization aware training EmbeddingBag module with fake quantize weight for training
convert_float_to_qat_embedding: convert a float torch.nn.Embedding module to a QAT Embedding module using from_float
convert_float_to_qat_embedding_bag: convert a float torch.nn.EmbeddingBag module to a QAT EmbeddingBag module using from_float
convert_qat_to_float_embedding: convert a QAT Embedding module back to a float torch.nn.Embedding module using to_float
